name: @roadmate/hooks
description: The React hooks all three RoadMate apps share. Created in Phase 4, when `useResource` was about to become a third copy (HANDOFF §6, Phase 3)
_comment_source: Ships uncompiled source like `@roadmate/ui` and `@roadmate/api`; Metro transpiles it through each app's babel config, so there is no build step to forget.
_comment_peers: expo-router is a peer, not a dependency: this package must resolve to the *app's* router instance, or `useFocusEffect` would be watching a navigation tree nothing is rendering.
